DECLARE @company NVARCHAR(50)  = '{{ $json.company }}';
DECLARE @nombre  NVARCHAR(512) = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('{{ $json.nombre }}')), '');

SELECT (
  SELECT
    t.id              AS template_id,
    t.name            AS template_name,
    t.language,
    t.content_type,
    t.parameter_format,
    t.meta_template_id,
    (
      SELECT
        d.id             AS det_id,
        d.component_type,
        d.component_format,
        d.text_content,
        d.sort_order,
        (
          SELECT
            b.button_type,
            b.button_text,
            b.button_url,
            b.button_phone,
            b.sort_order
          FROM c_commerce_message_template_button b
          WHERE b.template_det_id = d.id
          ORDER BY b.sort_order
          FOR JSON PATH
        ) AS buttons,
        (
          SELECT TOP 1 m.media_identifier
          FROM c_commerce_message_template_media m
          WHERE m.template_det_id = d.id
        ) AS media_identifier,
        (
          SELECT
            e.parameter_name,
            e.example_value
          FROM c_commerce_message_template_example e
          WHERE e.template_det_id = d.id
          FOR JSON PATH
        ) AS examples
      FROM c_commerce_message_template_det d
      WHERE d.template_id = t.id
        AND d.company = t.company
      ORDER BY d.sort_order
      FOR JSON PATH
    ) AS components
  FROM c_commerce_message_template t
  WHERE t.company = @company
    AND t.active = 1
    AND t.is_deleted = 0
    AND (@nombre IS NULL OR t.name LIKE '%' + @nombre + '%')
  ORDER BY t.name
  FOR JSON PATH
) AS resultado
